inputs: ClinVar records for HBB whose title is a single NM_000518.5 coding substitution c.<pos><ref>><alt>. Consequence is recomputed by evidna.analyze and must agree with ClinVar's protein change.

labels.excluded: every other classification, including uncertain and conflicting

split: Sort labeled records by VCV accession number. The highest 30 percent (newest) are held out; the rest are development. Scores on the held-out set are the headline.
baselines: majority class of the development set
metric: balanced accuracy, with the confusion matrix and counts
rule: Do not change predictor_v0 or the split after seeing labels. Any new predictor is v1 and is scored on the same held-out set, reported next to v0.
